name: Supabase
description: Supabase's hosted server manages projects: run SQL, apply migrations, read logs and deploy edge functions. Point it at a development project first.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (api.supabase.com) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
